The Curriculum Continues: Segmentation & Sizing

The curriculum is no longer 8 units. It's 9—and growing.

This week we're releasing Unit 9: Segmentation & Sizing. Before you can position a product, enable a sales team, or run a campaign, you need to answer a deceptively simple question: who are we going after?

This unit covers market segmentation (category, competition, growth quadrants), building TAM with AI assistance, customer segmentation (funnel stages, buying roles), and buyer tiers from SMB to Enterprise.

Start Unit 9 →

📰 AI + PMM News

Top 5 This Week

1. HubSpot Launches Agent Hub & Agent Builder

Just dropped: a unified console for AI agents plus no-code agent building for Professional and Enterprise customers. The agentic marketing stack is going mainstream.

2. Forbes: 94% of B2B Buyers Now Use AI in Their Journey

Per 6sense's 2025 report, nearly all B2B buyers use GenAI when researching vendors. By the time prospects visit your site, they've already asked ChatGPT about you.

3. BCG: Agentic AI Is Redefining Marketing Growth

"Autonomous systems learn, decide, and act alongside human teams." BCG's advice: CMOs who move first will win.

4. 82% Expect AI Agents to Handle ⅓ of Marketing Decisions

Kana's July 2026 survey: business leaders expect AI agents to handle routine marketing decisions within two years. Governance isn't ready—but adoption is happening anyway.

5. 66% of B2B Buyers Use AI for Vendor Research

Semrush surveyed 600+ B2B pros: 66% regularly use AI to research vendors, and 92% say AI shaped their most recent shortlist. Your content needs to work for machines, not just humans.
